sourceText: User (2026-07-28), after reviewing the red reproduction output: agreed to open a story that lands the red test as a registered guard and fixes the quorum downgrade collision. Earlier in the same conversation the user asked why the inconsistency mattered, then asked for a red test to prove the problem reproduces before any fix.
normalizedOutcome: A complete 3x2 quorum at the current material counts as 3/3 valid rounds even when a superseded quorum for the same runIds exists at an older material sharing its storyFilesHash, and a registered red test permanently guards that behaviour.
acceptanceClaim: The registered red test red-f88e-quorum-downgrade-collision.mjs exits 1 before the fix with the 0/3 collision message and exits 0 after it, with no manufactured duplicate-identity reasons.
